correctness.rationale: Conditioning on an upper record at position i makes the first i values a uniform i-subset and the ith value its maximum. Exact subset-order-statistic means give the conditional means at earlier, current, and later positions, from which the arbitrary-weight covariance follows by linearity. Squared displacement is affine in the weighted rank sum with weights j, yielding the Spearman formulas. Exact exhaustive replay through n=9 and independent finite-sum checks confirm every displayed specialization.

value.rationale: Upper records are a canonical online statistic of random permutations, while linear rank scores include central global ranking summaries. The theorem is reusable across all deterministic linear scores and reveals a prefix-weight mechanism rather than one isolated mixed moment. The Spearman specialization gives a monotone local record-position profile and a sharp global redundancy scale 3/sqrt(n log n), quantifying how record information overlaps with global squared rank displacement.
